name: Kadokura Riko
source:
A cheerful and spirited daughter who adores her mother

The only daughter of Ayako Kadokura, a student at Fujimura School. She often accompanies Ayako to the night school.

A cheerful and innocent girl who always brightens up the atmosphere with her positive energy, even at Fujimura School. Despite her cheerful nature, she never throws tantrums or causes trouble for others. She is a well-behaved and considerate daughter who always helps her beloved Ayako with housework and errands.
